data.description:
## Description

**What**: Weekly CI cron runs regenerate-strata-sdk-facts.sh against latest upstream HEAD. Substantive structural diffs trigger an advisory PR with a structured diff summary (not just title). Whitespace-only diffs do NOT trigger PRs. CI fresh-check (separate run, not weekly) detects hand-edits to AUTOGENERATED sections against last-committed HEAD baseline; emits `[B] strata-sdk-facts hand-edit at <file>:<line>; regenerate via plugins/dso/scripts/regenerate-strata-sdk-facts.sh`.
**Why**: Drift between pinned ref and upstream silently invalidates planning context unless surfaced.
**Scope**:
- IN: GitHub Actions cron workflow; substantive-vs-whitespace diff classifier; advisory-PR generator with structured diff summary; CI fresh-check job; manual-residual-index.json hand-edits permitted (not gated).
- OUT: Auto-update of pinned ref (manual ref bumps in v1).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, weekly cron runs against latest upstream HEAD ← Satisfies: behavioral guarantee drift-detection-correctness
- When complete, substantive structural diff opens advisory PR with structured summary ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, whitespace-only diff does NOT open PR (verified by synthetic-diff fixtures) ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, CI fresh-check fails on hand-edits to AUTO sections with the named error ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, manual-residual-index.json hand-edits do NOT trigger fresh-check failure ← Satisfies: SC5
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for diff classifier + PR-summary generator

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Cron failure must be observable (alerting / GitHub status)
- [Maintainability] Document the manual ref-bump procedure

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, weekly drift-detection CI cron opens advisory PR on substantive upstream change
